correctness.rationale: Using F(n+d)-F(n)=d(2n+d+1) and 4F(n)=(2n+1)^2+3, prime powers split into p|d with p≡1 mod3 (two Hensel-simple roots), p|(d²+3) with p>=5 (one affine root), and p=3 ramified valuation one iff n≡1 mod3 and 3|d. p=2 absent. A third shifted value forces p|d, giving G_{d,r}=gcd(F(n),d) for all r>=3. Independent congruence tests covered 24000 (d,n) instances; exact local residue counts, CRT product weights and root-translation invariance prove all divisor frequencies, maximum T and least period T. Mathematical proof covers all d,n>=1 and r>=2 beyond sampled finite checks.
